title: Opening stock
description: Before this place starts selling here: item costs loaded, opening stock received, counted, and a blind recount of at least a tenth of the count agreeing at 98% or more.

statusHelp.NOT_STARTED: No opening stock has been received here yet. Receive it with the source Opening stock.
statusHelp.RECEIVING: Opening stock is received. Print the labels, tag every item, then start a count by scanning the labels.
statusHelp.COUNTING: A count is open. When it is saved, a second person does a blind recount of at least a tenth of its lines.
statusHelp.RECOUNT_FAILED: The blind recount did not pass. Count the place again and recount.
statusHelp.PASSED: The blind recount passed and the count it checked is posted.

blockers.COSTS_MISSING: {{items}} item(s) have no cost yet. A manager or the accountant loads item costs first.
blockers.UNCOSTED_OPENING_RECEIPT: An opening receipt here has lines without a cost. Reverse it and receive those items again with a cost.
blockers.SAMPLE_TOO_SMALL: The recount checked {{compared}} line(s); at least {{needed}} are needed (a tenth of the count).
blockers.AGREEMENT_BELOW_98: The recount agreed on {{percent}}% of its lines; 98% is needed.
blockers.COUNT_NOT_POSTED: The recount passed, but the count it checked is still open. Post that count so its figures become stock.

otherWithoutCost: {{items}} other item(s) of the shop have no cost yet (not at this place).
uncostedReceipts: Receipts with lines without a cost: {{numbers}}
